subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: Should Discord voice startup switch to delayed/retry autoJoin with account-scoped @discordjs/voice groups after this branch is refreshed and the focused tests are updated?
rationale: The implementation matches the dependency's group contract, but it changes Discord voice session ownership and startup timing in a way that green CI alone will not settle.

options.title: Refresh And Prove The Voice Contract
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, update the ready/resumed and group-key tests, and re-check focused or live Discord voice behavior before merge.

options.title: Accept The Timing Tradeoff
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the delayed retry schedule if Discord voice owner review confirms startup, leave, and rejoin behavior are desired.

options.title: Pause If It Cannot Be Reproven
options.body: If the multi-account Discord voice scenario cannot be shown again after refresh, pause or replace this PR rather than landing a timing-sensitive workaround.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove The Voice Contract
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, update the ready/resumed and group-key tests, and re-check focused or live Discord voice behavior before merge.
